about: can2cup.com's own known issues. scripts/assemble-assets.mjs in the public repo appends these to the project's list; ids must not collide.

issues.title: Relay unreachable from this machine while other sites work
issues.fix: Try https://www.can2cup.com instead of the bare domain (some resolvers only return IPv6 for the apex). www.can2cup.com is ANOTHER NAME for the same relay — same signing key — not a different service: after `can2cup setup --relay https://www.can2cup.com`, `can2cup rooms` will show it under the same relay key as the others.
